description: Read a Juggle (whyjuggle.com) babysitting/petsitting FAMILY account from a shell with curl + jq, no MCP server needed. Covers your sits/jobs and who applied, one booking in detail, sitter search, favorites, sitter profiles and reviews, your message conversations, the payments summary (rates, cards by brand/last 4, promo credit, transactions in dollars), and the public city and rate list. Use it when someone asks about Juggle, whyjuggle, their babysitter or petsitter bookings, sitter applicants, or messages with a sitter, and the juggle-mcp tools aren't available, or when a script needs the data. Read-only: posting a sit, accepting or declining a sitter, cancelling, messaging, favoriting and reviewing are confirm-gated tools in juggle-mcp.
